records.synonym_note: Dalea mollis var. neomexicana and Parosela neomexicana are homotypic synonyms. POWO recognizes three varieties (longipila, megaladenia, neomexicana); no variety is established by the source row.
records.alias_duplicate_disposition: Retain historical synonyms as aliases, no additional card for same concept

records.synonym_note: Kuhnistera purpurea, Petalostemon purpureus, Psoralea purpurea are homotypic synonyms. Two accepted varieties, arenicola and purpurea; source rank is species only. Dalea tenuis remains separate.
records.alias_duplicate_disposition: Retain historical synonyms as aliases, no additional card for same concept
